pr_title: create the audio output stream on demand
pr_body:
# Objective

- Fixes #9798
- Bevy starts an audio output stream even when not needed which can cause error

## Solution

- Start the output stream only when an entity wants to play audio
pr_comments: Do you have any idea how long does it take to add the `AudioOutput`? If it's below something like 1 ms this looks good to me, otherwise I think we should probably mark the linked issue as "won't fix" to avoid introducing delays for users following the happy path.

> Do you have any idea how long does it take to add the AudioOutput

Ouch, it probably depends on the platform, but 80ms on macOS
I think that pushes this into the "Won't Fix" category for me. That will be perceptible, and there are better workarounds available.

issue_context.title: Terminal outputting ALSA function 'snd_pcm_poll_descriptors' failed with error 'UnknownErrno: Unknown errno'
issue_context.body:
## Bevy version 0.11
##archlinux with sway and pulseaudio
I used the line2d function in a piece of code here https://pastebin.com/VdShgSSJ.

The console started outputting 
"an error occurred on output stream: A backend-specific error has occurred: ALSA function 'snd_pcm_poll_descriptors' failed with error 'UnknownErrno: Unknown errno'" very fast, this has not caused any issues for me besides clogging up the console, I'm happy to show any logs or do any testing if needed.


The code I am using makes no audio calls and shouldn't be interacting with ALSA
comments: Does this still happen with default features disabled for Bevy?
Yes I'm still getting this to output in the terminal after removing use std::default; and #[feature(default_fn)] good question though that narrows it down. Is there any other debugging i can do?

Ah no, I meant "we should make sure Bevy's audio features are disabled"!

See: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/features.html#the-default-feature

In this case, try changing the exact features of Bevy that you rely in, starting with `default_features = false` and then progressively enabling the features needed to make your code compile.

Building and running with the Cargo.toml as [dependencies] bevy = { version = "0.11", default-features = false } runs with no errors whatsoever however i had to remove everything except running the app to make it compile without any complaints. I'm currently trying to add use:bevy for all the features but can't seem to find what the import paths for Gizmos, Color or Camera2dbundle are.
Check out the features list [here](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/Cargo.toml). I suspect you'll need `bevy_gizmos` and `bevy_core_pipeline`.

While setting the correct features is the correct way for long term as it improves performances and reduces build time, I tried a "fix" in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/9811. This PR should delay the interaction with ALSA until you actually try to play audio
Thanks both of you this is huge! I'm glad bevy has such active maintainers
Closing as won't fix, since there's a good workaround (don't include features you don't need), and the spawn-as-needed fix introduces unacceptable lag.
